result.question: Why is Athaliah killed at king's house?

readings.answer: Because she must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
readings.support: She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.

assessments.reason: The passage states, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD,” explaining why she was taken out and then killed at the palace; this matches the key’s reason that the priest said not in Yahweh’s house.

result.reason: The text explicitly gives the reason: the priest ordered she not be executed in the LORD’s house, so she was killed at the palace instead.
